ui.requestFailed: DeliDev could not complete this request.
ui.failure.invalid_argument: Check the input values before submitting again.
ui.failure.not_found: Refresh the current list before acting.
ui.failure.conflict: The item changed. Inspect its latest state and retain the original request.
ui.failure.permission_denied: This connection is not authorized for the action. Check its access.
ui.failure.unavailable: The operation is unavailable. Inspect accepted work before retrying the same request.
ui.failure.server_unavailable: Check the selected connection and inspect accepted work before retrying the same request.
ui.failure.confirmation_required: Inspect the current item and provide the required confirmation.
ui.failure.missing_input: Provide the required input before submitting.
ui.failure.unsupported: This action is unsupported by the selected server or native adapter.
ui.failure.recovery_required: Inspect the original operation and its recovery controls before acting again.
ui.failure.budget_reached: The budget limit was reached. Inspect the session's budget and original operation.
ui.failure.resource_exhausted: A capacity limit was reached. Inspect capacity before submitting another request.
ui.failure.cursor_expired: This page cursor expired. Refresh the list to read its current first page.
ui.failure.provider_disabled: This provider is disabled. Inspect its configuration before continuing.
ui.failure.canceled: The request was canceled. Its accepted effects may remain; inspect the original operation.
ui.failure.internal: The request could not complete. Inspect the technical details and accepted work before retrying.
